title.value: Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law
title.provenance: Provides that the amendatory Act may be referred to as the Perfluoroalkyl and Polyfluoroalkyl Chemicals Consumer Protection Law.

status.provenance: Amends the Illinois Procurement Code and the Environmental Protection Act.

date.provenance: No specific date provided in the document, but it mentions effective dates for different sections.

pfas_definition.provenance: ‘PFAS chemical’ means any of the perfluoroalkyl substances or polyfluoroalkyl substances included in the United States Environmental Protection Agency's expanded ToxCast chemical inventory.

date.provenance: On and after January 1, 2025, no person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical: Carpets or rugs, Fabric treatments, Food packaging, Juvenile products, Oil and gas products, Apparel.

who.provenance: No person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical: Carpets or rugs, Fabric treatments, Food packaging, Juvenile products, Oil and gas products, Apparel.

products.provenance: No person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product in the following product categories if the product contains an intentionally added PFAS chemical: Carpets or rugs, Fabric treatments, Food packaging, Juvenile products, Oil and gas products, Apparel.

value: sale or resale of a used product
exceptions.provenance: (d) The commissioner may not take action under paragraph (b) or (c) with respect to a pesticide, as defined under chapter 18B, a fertilizer, an agricultural liming material, a plant amendment, or a soil amendment as defined under chapter 18C, unless the commissioner of agriculture approves the action. This section does not apply to: (1) a product for which federal law governs the presence of PFAS in the product in a manner that preempts state authority; (2) a product regulated under section 325F.072 or 325F.075; or (3) the sale or resale of a used product. (b) Subdivisions 4 and 5 do not apply to a prosthetic or orthotic device or to any product that is a medical device or drug or that is otherwise used in a medical setting or in medical applications regulated by the United States Food and Drug Administration.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: Beginning January 1, 2025, a person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute for sale in this state any product that contains intentionally added PFAS, unless the commissioner has determined by rule that the use of PFAS in the product is a currently unavoidable use.

intentionally_added.provenance: No person shall sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any product that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals.
